result.topic_en: Formula-only calculation reducing a double integral (arising in Riemann's air-wave / gas dynamics work) to a single integral and then expressing it via Riemann P-functions as a hypergeometric function of $-\frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}$.
result.transcription:
$\left(\frac{\sigma'}{\sigma}\right)^{\frac{1}{k-1}}\iint \frac{1}{2(u-u')+\sigma(\alpha+\frac{1}{\alpha})+\sigma'(\alpha'+\frac{1}{\alpha'})}\,\alpha^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}\alpha'^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}\,\partial\log\alpha\,\partial\log\alpha'$

$\alpha=\alpha\rho$ [?] $\alpha'=\frac{\alpha}{\rho}$

$\frac{1}{2(u-u')+[-\ldots-]\rho(\sigma\alpha+\frac{\sigma'}{\alpha})+\frac{1}{\rho}(\frac{\sigma}{\alpha}+\alpha\sigma')}\partial\log\rho\,\partial\log\alpha\;\alpha^{-\frac{2}{k-1}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{(u-u')^2-\sigma^2-\sigma\sigma'(\alpha^2+\frac{1}{\alpha^2})-\sigma'^2}}\,\alpha^{-\frac{2}{k-1}}\,\partial\log\alpha$

$\rho^2(\alpha\sigma+\frac{\sigma'}{\alpha})+2\rho(u-u')+(\frac{\sigma}{\alpha}+\alpha\sigma')=0$ $\quad\frac{\partial\rho}{(\rho-\rho_1)(\rho-\rho_2)}=2\pi i\frac{1}{\rho_1-\rho_2}$

$\rho(\alpha\sigma+\frac{\sigma'}{\alpha})+(u-u')=\pm\sqrt{(u-u')^2-\sigma^2-\sigma\sigma'(\alpha^2+\frac{1}{\alpha^2})-\sigma'^2}$

$v=\left(\frac{\sigma'}{\sigma}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{k-1}}\int\frac{x^{-\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x}{\sqrt{(u-u')^2-\sigma^2-\sigma\sigma'(x+\frac{1}{x})-\sigma'^2}}$

$\frac{1}{2}(p+q)^{-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{k-1}}(p'+q')^{-\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{k-1}}\int\frac{x^{-\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x}{\sqrt{\frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}+\frac{(x+1)^2}{4x}}}$

$4\frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}=-\alpha-\frac{1}{\alpha}-2$

$\int(1-\frac{x}{\alpha})^{-\frac{1}{2}}(1-\alpha x)^{-\frac{1}{2}}x^{-\frac{1}{k-1}-\frac{1}{2}}\partial x = \alpha^{\frac{1}{k-1}}\int(1-x)^{-\frac{1}{2}}(1-\alpha\alpha x)^{-\frac{1}{2}}x^{-\frac{1}{k-1}-\frac{1}{2}}\partial x = [-P\begin{pmatrix}-\frac{1}{k-1} & 0 & 0 & \alpha\alpha\\ \frac{1}{2} & \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{k-1} & 0 & \end{pmatrix}-]$

$= P\begin{pmatrix}-\frac{1}{2k-2} & -\frac{1}{2k-2} & 0 & \alpha\alpha\\ \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2k-2} & \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2k-2} & 0 & \end{pmatrix}$ $\quad[-=(1-\alpha\alpha)^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}P\begin{pmatrix}\frac{1}{2} & 0 & -\frac{1}{k-1} & \frac{1+\alpha\alpha}{1-\alpha\alpha}\\ -1 & \infty & 1 & \end{pmatrix}^{2}-]$

$\frac{1+\alpha\alpha}{1-\alpha\alpha}$

$= P\begin{pmatrix}0 & 0 & -\frac{1}{2k-2} & \left(\frac{1+\alpha\alpha}{1-\alpha\alpha}\right)^2\\ \frac{1}{2} & 0 & \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2k-2} & \end{pmatrix}$ $\quad[-=(1-\alpha\alpha)^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}P\begin{pmatrix}0 & -\frac{2}{k-1} & 0 & \frac{1}{2}(\alpha+\frac{1}{\alpha})\\ 0 & 4 & 0 & \end{pmatrix}-]$

$= P\begin{pmatrix}0 & \frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{k-1} & 0 & -\frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}\\ 0 & \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{k-1} & 0 & \end{pmatrix} = P\begin{pmatrix}0 & 0 & \frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{k-1} & \frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}\\ 0 & 0 & \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{k-1} & \end{pmatrix}$

$pp'+pq'+qp'+qq'$
$pq-p'q-q'p+p'q'$

$1-\frac{1}{x}=\frac{(p+q)(p'+q')}{(p-p')(q-q')}+1$
$=\frac{(p+q')(p'+q)}{(p-p')(q-q')}$

$v=\frac{1}{2}(p+q)^{-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{k-1}}(p'+q')^{-\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{k-1}}\,F\left(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{k-1},\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{k-1},1,-\frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}\right)$

methods.what: Change of variables in the double integral ($\alpha\to\alpha\rho$, $\alpha'\to\alpha/\rho$) and evaluation of the $\rho$-integral by residues, reducing to a single integral with a square root
Quadratic equation for $\rho$ whose discriminant gives the square-root kernel
Single-integral representation of the Riemann function $v$ in terms of $p,q,p',q'$
Relation linking the parameter $\alpha$ to the cross-ratio-like variable
Euler integral expressed as Riemann P-function and transformed (quadratic transformation) to a P-function of $-\frac{(p-p')(q-q')}{(p+q)(p'+q')}$
Final closed form of $v$ as a Gauss hypergeometric function
